# Phase_Synchronization_Memory

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The use of synchronized phase relationships among oscillators as the encoded states of an associative memory network. It enables energy-efficient, in-network storage and recall by leveraging the natural dynamics of neuromorphic oscillator arrays.
